messages.subject: Renjin standard output
parts:
Hi....

I´ve just published version 0.2.1 of SciCom on RubyGem.  Installation is done by installing jruby and then doing on the command line: jruby -S gem install scicom.

When I run my test suite on the console, everything works fine.  However, when I start jirb - the interactive console, trying to print anything does not work.  I´m guessing that this has to do with standard output of Renjin that might be sending the output somewhere else than to jirb.  How does Renjin controls the output when it receives a print such as eval("print(1)")?  Again, doing this on the console works fine, but it does not on the Ruby Interactive Console.

Any ideas?

Thanks
